pqs10.name: PQS Extinguisher 10 Lbs
pqs10.desc: Suitable for warehouses, offices, commercial stores, and freight vehicles. Maximum coverage against ordinary combustibles, flammable liquids, and electrical equipment.

pqs20.name: PQS Extinguisher 20 Lbs
pqs20.desc: Extended discharge capacity for manufacturing sheds, chemical plants, service stations, and heavy industries.

co210.name: CO2 Extinguisher 10 Lbs
co210.desc: Clean gaseous agent, non-electrically conductive. Leaves no chemical residue and does not damage servers, control rooms, or sensitive medical gear.

co215.name: CO2 Extinguisher 15 Lbs
co215.desc: Greater range and discharge duration for industrial machinery, transformers, and telecommunications rooms without corrosion.

water25.name: Pressurized Water Extinguisher 2.5 Gal
water25.desc: Stainless steel cylinder. Superior cooling effect for timber storage, paper records, textiles, and compacted cardboard.

k6.name: Potassium Acetate Extinguisher 6 L
k6.desc: Engineered for commercial kitchens, high-temperature deep fryers, and animal/vegetable fats. Generates a saponifying smothering foam blanket.
